topic: Reviewing analytics file discrepancies and fixes
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on unusual inconsistencies found in the analytics files stored on S3, specifically regarding differing dates and lengths between old and new data. It was suspected that external systems might be overwriting or updating the files during the day.

[me] identified an error in a script parameter and confirmed that it appears external parties are requesting and uploading updated versions of the file over existing ones.

[me] committed a fix to the relevant repository for review.
decisions: A fix was committed to address the incorrect script parameter.
action_items: Someone needs to check the newly committed code (GitHub link provided) to ensure no syntax errors were introduced.
Request to run a separate 'data upload' job immediately to test the fix and confirm data retrieval from Git.
